Coco and Deliveroo announce a UK robot-delivery rollout

The rollout starts with Canary Wharf in October and plans four further cities, while riders continue to handle most orders.

Coco Robotics / PR Newswire ↗5 October 2026English editorial summary
StoryImages 1

A staged UK introduction

Coco Robotics and Deliveroo announced an exclusive UK robot-delivery partnership on October 5. Canary Wharf is scheduled first in October, followed by Milton Keynes, Leeds, Stockton on Tees and Nottingham over subsequent weeks and months. The announcement describes a phased rollout, not service already operating across all five locations.

Local trips need local support

The electric sidewalk robots travel at walking pace and target short delivery journeys. Initial participating businesses include Patty&Bun, Signorelli and Beam. Expansion includes local depots, charging and maintenance operations. Deliveroo says its rider network will continue fulfilling most orders, with robots providing another option for suitable trips.

Sharing the sidewalk

Coco also plans to share detected sidewalk hazards with BlindSquare to support alerts for blind and partially sighted pedestrians. Coverage, delivery consistency and responses to blocked routes will matter as service begins. The release does not yet provide independent performance results from the planned UK operation.
